# Pull request

## Outcome

Describe the user-visible result.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and their results.

## Compatibility and privacy

Describe breaking changes, migrations, permission changes, or data-handling impact. Write `None` when there is no impact.

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept this change focused.
- [ ] I ran the target repository's documented checks.
- [ ] I updated tests and consumer documentation when behavior changed.
- [ ] I removed credentials, personal data, private content, and local-only artifacts.
